notes.title: Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition - Plays Great on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Squad!  Listen up!

We're absolutely thrilled to announce that Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition is, to our knowledge, completely compatible with the Steam Deck!

Our team has been diving deep into the hellish landscapes on Valve's awesome handheld, and we're stoked to report that Mad Devils runs smoothly and plays great. We've put it through its paces to ensure you can take your Nazi-slaying, demon-powered adventure with you wherever you are.

So, if you've been itching to blast through the circles of hell on the go, now's your chance! We've worked to make the experience seamless on the Steam Deck.

We can't wait for you to try out Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition on your Steam Deck. Grab yours, jump in, and show those demonic Nazis who's boss, whether you're on your couch or on the move!

Happy Nazi hunting!

- The Itzy Interactive Team

notes.title: Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/815ffce2d39f2a6b1500b710551d4dbb3aaa5a69.jpg[/img]
Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition is now live!

Get ready to raise hell as Itzy Interactive Inc. unleashes Mad Devils: Damned-finitive Edition, the ultimate demon-fueled WWII shooter. Available on Steam (and coming to the PlayStation 5/Xbox Series X/S Aug 13, 2024) this enhanced edition takes the co-op arcade experience to the next level.

Two New Heroes Join the Fight:
•	The roster of playable demon soldiers expands from six to eight, each with unique abilities and weapons, ready to unleash hell on the battlefield.

Damned-finitive Enhancements:
•	Improved Post-Game: Continue the fight after completing the campaign, replay levels with any character, and unlock new challenges.
•	Enhanced Arsenal: Elemental weapon upgrades have been boosted, unleashing devastating new effects and strategies against the demonic hordes. Fire, ice, and lightning will bend to your will as you obliterate your foes in spectacular fashion.
•	Streamlined UI: Refined menu navigation and clearer information for a more intuitive interface.
•	Countless Fixes and Improvements: Numerous bug fixes, performance enhancements, and quality-of-life updates ensure the smoothest and most enjoyable Mad Devils experience yet.
•	Steam Deck Support: Take the demonic action on the go with Steam Deck support.

 Hell hath no fury like a squad of resurrected soldiers with a score to settle!

notes.title: The Mad Devils Begin Their Mission In Hell
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/9f3d0265fb7164908196761ea07be381b6c98e1b.png[/img]

As a small studio and after many years of development, we're proud to say [i]Mad Devils[/i] has officially launched on Steam! 

While the console launch on PlayStation and Xbox is still some way away, we'll be working hard over the next few months to continue improve upon what we have. From bug fixes, to DLC and the addition of new characters, we're far from finished with [i]Mad Devils[/i] and its universe.

For those of you who've dived in early, from our initial demo right through to our PlayTest, thank you! 

As a treat, here's some information on our upcoming update.

[b]Havildar Jai Khan[/b] grew up in British India and enlisted in the British Indian Army in 1937 where he rose to the rank of Havildar by WWII and was switched from the mechanized infantry division to a light division after fighting in Burma where his reputation as a leader prompted a British officer by the name of Robert Harris to reach out to him about a transfer to a specialized unit called the Mad Devils. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/7e42e7f7152d32c6c3087b1b517dac1d8ab267fa.png[/img] 

[b]Nika Malkov[/b] is the daughter of Mad Devils' sniper, Victor Malkov.  A young confident woman she seems like she's lived through 4 wars and is proficient, like her father, as a sniper. The problem is, when last Victor saw his daughter she was just a child.  How did she become a prisoner of Major Stauss and what is she doing in this hellish domain?  As she picks up her father's rifle, the story and past of this headstrong and willful fighter is very much a mystery, as is her recent metamorphosis.    

/MadDevils

notes.title: Online Co-Op/Multiplayer is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/32e23d66ce0da98df8a8ec45aae70a47308d493c.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

We hope you've all had a good week. Over the last few weeks we've been hard at working getting our online co-op/multiplayer functionality of Mad Devils up and running. It's more difficult than you might imagine, but I'm pleased to say that not only has this now been implemented, but players can now dive in and put Mad Devils through its paces.

We aren't expecting that it's bug free, but from our internal tests - and from early feedback from influencers - it's working well. 

If you'd like to try it yourself, please don't hesitate to sign up to our PlayTest (on our Steam page) and you and a friend will be able to jump straight in.

In the meantime, we'll be sharing our launch date next week, as well as some details on when Mad Devils is coming to consoles (a lot of you have been asking). While our launch has been pushed back a little bit (don't worry, only a month), it'll give us a little bit more room to polish the game. 

Stay tuned for more updates Monday!

/MadDevils

notes.title: Diana - Much More Than Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/aa8c774ba9626970e7b14401579da59c1d9051b1.png[/img]

Hey all! 

With the Steam Festival drawing to a close, and with hundreds of thousands of you taking a look at Mad Devils (thank you!) we wanted to shine a little more light on Diana, Asher's primary support character.

Diana Cross was born in New York to a well to do family where she trained and worked as a nurse until falling for and marrying a French diplomat. They moved to Paris shortly after they were married, where Diana continued to work as a nurse despite her wealth, social standing and her husband’s objections. Shortly after the Nazi invasion of France, Diana and her husband attempted to flee but were captured by Gestapo. Diana’s husband faked a fit, creating a diversion that enabled Diana to escape. She fled to Britain and joined up with Churchill’s Baker Street Irregulars, vowing to return and free her husband. Through the SOE she was trained in various methods of espionage. She also received piloting training for special missions over occupied Europe. She met and impressed Cpl. Harris and ultimately became an asset to the Mad Devils, who utilized her skills on a number of missions. Her husband’s whereabouts are still unknown.

Where her kit is concerned, and similarly to Asher, it's a varied mix of offensive and defensive capabilities. That said, it has a different tone. Rather than pure burst, Diana's abilities are a little more...nuanced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/a9c3626ee896f3ddacca8c096ef0f6b28459648a.png[/img]

This is just a sample of the abilities in the game, and as you might notice between Asher and Diana, they're somewhat opposites: Asher deals in fire and explosions, while Diana handles more defensive, ethereal effects. As a pairing, you'll have to mix and match multiple abilities in order to take on tougher and tougher foes. 

While we'll be talking more about Diana in a future post (we're aiming for tomorrow!), it's important to remember that Mad Devils is very much a co-op experiencing, so ensuring there's synergy between you and your partner is key. 

Oh, and as always, here's our favorite render!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/4631f0078601acc4366358d531e3f4328c904a00.png[/img]

/Mad Devils Team

notes.title: Asher - Hell Bent On Revenge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/eedf875c7dc3ec22ae6f294f3c3bc6b38d8017c5.jpg[/img]

Hey all! 

Today we wanted to talk about our favourite skeleton: Asher. As the lead protagonist in Mad Devils, he's not only a cornerstone of all play, but is pivotal to its story. 

Jack Asher, to give him his full title, is an American mill worker who joined the army after his military father’s death overseas. He rose in rank via battlefield promotions while deployed in Northern Africa and Italy where his unit became involved in operations working to stop Axis occult efforts. His family includes two younger brothers and his elderly mother. Asher originally resisted his father’s insistence that he follow his footsteps and enlist. He left home at an early age, only enlisting after his father’s death and his younger brother’s enlistment.

As you can see [url=https://www.ign.com/videos/mad-devils-motion-comic-trailer]in our first Motion Comic[/url], Asher's arrival into Mad Devils isn't without incident...

Where his kit is concerned, it's a varied mix of offensive and defensive capabilities. Here's a couple for you to take a look at.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39195600/68dee3a7f5d59853004258e3113f6e70440b27fe.png[/img]

This is just a sample of the abilities in the game, and as you might notice between Asher and Diana, they're somewhat opposites: Asher deals in fire and explosions, while Diana handles more defensive, ethereal effects. As a pairing, you'll have to mix and match multiple abilities in order to take on tougher and tougher foes. 

While we'll be talking more about Diana in a future post (we're aiming for tomorrow!), it's important to remember that Mad Devils is very much a co-op experiencing, so ensuring there's synergy between you and your partner is key. 

Oh, and here's an awesome [url=http://maddevilsgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Asher_web.mp4]render of Asher[/url]. Enjoy!

/Mad Devils Team

Hey all!

Now that we've taken advantage of Valve's playtest feature for Mad Devils, and with over 250 of you diving in to roadtest and bug squash, we thought we'd provide a quick update on what we've been working on now you've (kindly) identified some key issues!

[list]

[*] Diana Shadow Attack crashes game
